summary: Rentiq Udaipur - Equipment rental management system with Internet Identity authentication, admin approval workflows, inventory, challans, payments, petty cash, and client balance tracking. Currently reverting from version 77 (public/no-auth) back to version 71 (authenticated with access controls).
architectural_notes: Version 71 had Internet Identity authentication with admin approval workflows and role-based access control
Version 77 removed all authentication, making the app fully public - this needs to be reverted
Backend canister ID needs correction: user provided two different IDs (c05156bde8c3af0dd27a09a2167b2c6b3b00177 vs c05l66bde8c3af0dd27a09a2167b2c6b3b001177)
Migration.mo file added in v77 must be removed as part of rollback
User requests complete restoration of v71 state including all data behavior and authentication flows
known_issues: Current version 77 has no authentication - anyone can access all features and data
Version 77 removed Internet Identity authentication that existed in version 71
Backend canister connection may be incorrect - conflicting IDs provided by user
Data created in public v77 state will require login access after v71 restoration

existing_features.title: Re-enable AuthApprovalGate component in frontend/src/components/common/AuthApprovalGate.tsx to block unauthenticated and unapproved users from accessing application routes
Restore SignInScreen component in frontend/src/components/common/SignInScreen.tsx to provide Internet Identity login interface
Restore ApprovalRequiredScreen component in frontend/src/components/common/ApprovalRequiredScreen.tsx to display pending approval status for logged-in but unapproved users
Restore SignInRequiredDialog component in frontend/src/components/common/SignInRequiredDialog.tsx to prompt users to authenticate before performing restricted actions
Restore useApprovalStatus hook in frontend/src/hooks/useApprovalStatus.ts to check user approval and admin status with backend
Restore useBootstrapAdmin hook in frontend/src/hooks/useBootstrapAdmin.ts to enable automatic admin bootstrapping for first admin domain user
Restore useStaffRestrictions hook in frontend/src/hooks/useStaffRestrictions.ts to enforce staff mode restrictions on bulk upload and delete operations based on app mode and admin status
Restore AccessManagementPage in frontend/src/pages/AccessManagementPage.tsx as admin-only page for viewing and managing user approval requests

Re-enable authentication and approval checks in all mutation operations across frontend dialogs (ChallanFormDialog, ChallanEditDialog, InventoryFormDialog, PaymentFormDialog, PettyCashFormDialog, ClientBulkUploadDialog, etc.)
